C arc025.clients-in-infrastructure OL ARC-025,GOV-012 DEFAULT ;; Named, typed and keyed clients are valid; choose the simplest model for consumer and lifetime; outbound API clients normally live in Infrastructure. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc025.app-unaware-http OL ARC-025 MUST ;; Application does not need to know an external service uses HTTP (Infrastructure implements the Application abstraction). ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc022.typed-client-singleton OL ARC-022 MUST_NOT ;; Do not capture a transient typed client inside a singleton without understanding lifetime implications. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov012.client-model-clarity OL GOV-012 MUST_NOT ;; Do not choose keyed clients (or make typed/keyed/named clients mandatory) automatically; prefer the model with clearest ownership and lifetime. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hcf-handlers EX ARC-025,API-011 MUST_NOT ;; Use DelegatingHandler only for genuine HTTP pipeline concerns (auth header acquisition, correlation propagation, request signing), never for business decisions. ;; = ;; none ;; Handler-responsibility rule not in the oracle.
C run003.pass-caller-token OL RUN-003 MUST ;; Pass the caller's CancellationToken to outbound calls; do not replace it with CancellationToken.None unless the operation must outlive the request; do not ignore cancellation. ;; = ;; Operation intentionally outlives the incoming request. ;;
C arc025.translate-responses OL ARC-025 MUST ;; Infrastructure translates remote responses into Application-facing abstractions/explicit outcomes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hcf-response-mapping EX ARC-025,API-003 MUST_NOT ;; Do not blindly call EnsureSuccessStatusCode when remote statuses carry contract meaning; do not expose every upstream status through your API or map every upstream failure mechanically to one status. ;; = ;; none ;; Response-mapping rules beyond ARC-025.
C run017.honor-retry-after OL RUN-017 DEFAULT ;; Honor Retry-After on remote 429 if the retry policy supports it; outbound retry and inbound responses are separate decisions. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run016.before-retry OL RUN-015,RUN-016 MUST ;; A timeout is normally required for external I/O; retry/circuit breaker are not mandatory; before retry determine transience, repeat safety, idempotency support and duplicate risk; do not assume PUT/DELETE are operationally safe merely by HTTP definition. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hcf-headers EX - MUST_NOT ;; Apply per-request values (dynamic tokens) to the request or via a handler; do not mutate shared DefaultRequestHeaders concurrently for request-specific values. ;; = ;; none ;; HttpClient header-safety rule not in the oracle.
C x.hcf-serialization EX - PREFER ;; Prefer System.Net.Http.Json/System.Text.Json where sufficient; use explicit serialization options when the external contract differs from application defaults. ;; = ;; none ;; Serializer choice preference not in the oracle.
C arc025.no-domain-as-remote-contract OL ARC-025,ARC-002 MUST_NOT ;; Do not reuse internal Domain entities as remote API contracts merely to avoid mapping. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run005.test-scope OL RUN-005 ALLOWED ;; Constructing new HttpClient(testHandler) in a focused test is fine; the HttpClient lifetime rule concerns production code. ;; = ;; Tests. ;;
